composition_contract.anti_template_rule: Transformations are not topics, claims, themes, explanations or caveat order. Claim records may only constrain, support or correct the already-authored route.
composition_contract.route_rule: Commit one materially observable carrier moving through ordered changes in the world, material or action. Each change must create a question or consequence before claim prose becomes visible.

response.rule: You may increase source-level factual resolution inside this graph. A new claim, causal conclusion, thesis, contradiction or generalization requires research/evidence authority. Call resolve_claims before submission when the task packet requires it.
